# Sample Workers Compensation Wording (fictional)

> Written for testing only. Not a real policy, wording or company document, and contains no customer data.

## Section 1. Benefits

### WC-1.1 Medical expenses
We pay reasonable medical expenses for a work-related injury, with no dollar limit.

### WC-1.2 Wage replacement
We pay two thirds of the injured worker's average weekly wage while they are unable to work, subject to the state
maximum.

### WC-1.3 Death benefits
We pay the statutory death benefit to a worker's dependants when a work-related injury causes death.

## Section 2. Duties

### WC-2.1 Reporting
The employer must report an injury within 7 days of becoming aware of it.

### WC-2.2 Return to work
The employer must offer suitable light duties when the treating doctor certifies that the worker can perform them.
